ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)
module_role: Packet-based serial display interface stack inside a SoC, layered as Application → Low Level Protocol → Lane Management → PHY (per DSI §4.1). Provides the wire-level transport for both Video Mode pixel streaming (DPI-2-like) and Command Mode command/parameter delivery (DBI-2-like + DCS).

integration_overview.wire_directions: Clock Lane host → peripheral only; Data Lane 0 bidirectional in LP for Command Mode; additional Data Lanes 1..3 host → peripheral only.
integration_overview.no_chip_select: No CS line; point-to-point pair with VC[1:0] in DI byte providing logical multi-channel multiplexing (up to 4 VCs).
integration_overview.no_addressing_at_dsi_layer: DSI Protocol Layer does not address a register file; DCS commands carry vendor / DCS-standardized command codes inside DSI Short / Long Packets.
integration_overview.controller_choices: Host processor is always the Clock Lane driver and the dominant HS payload source. Peripheral can drive LP only on Data Lane 0 (Command Mode bidirectional config).
integration_overview.handshake: BTA (Bus Turn-Around) provides explicit ownership handover for reverse-direction Acknowledge / Error Report / Read Response / TE.

responsibilities: ECC Generation and Testing on header
Checksum Generation and Testing on payload
Pixel-to-Byte Packing Formats (RGB565 / RGB666 packed / RGB666 loosely packed / RGB888)
Command Generation / Interpretation (DCS over DSI Short/Long packets)

interface_categories: Host D-PHY transmitter on Clock Lane + Data Lanes 0..N-1 (HS driver + LP driver + LP-CD on Data Lane 0 + lane controller).
Peripheral D-PHY receiver on Clock Lane + Data Lanes (HS receiver + LP receiver + LP-CD on Data Lane 0 + sync-pattern hunter + clock recovery).
Host Lane Distribution / Merging block — distributes outgoing packet bytes round-robin across N Data Lanes; merges incoming Data Lane 0 reverse-direction bytes.
DSI Protocol Layer — header builder (DI + WC) + ECC computer / verifier; payload builder + CRC computer / verifier; EoTp generator / detector; BTA controller; Error Register accumulator (peripheral).
Application interface — Pixel-to-Byte Packing block (4 pixel formats); Command Generation / Interpretation block (DCS); Tearing Effect controller (in Command Mode peripheral).
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point — host ↔ one peripheral per physical DSI Link (normative scope).
Multi-peripheral via Virtual Channel (informative) — single physical Link carries up to 4 logical streams via VC[1:0]; details of multi-peripheral wiring are outside DSI v1.01 normative scope.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: All Lanes idle LP-11 (Stop state) between transmissions; peripheral in LP-RX until host begins HS Entry; peripheral's Maximum Return Packet Size defaults to 1 byte at power-on / reset.
soc_dependent_items: Number of Data Lanes (1..4) — chosen to match required pixel-stream bandwidth.
Operating mode: Command Mode (with on-panel frame buffer) and/or Video Mode (real-time pixel stream).
Video Mode packet sequence: Non-Burst with Sync Pulses / Non-Burst with Sync Events / Burst.
Pixel format: 16-bpp RGB565, 18-bpp RGB666 Packed, 18-bpp RGB666 Loosely Packed, 24-bpp RGB888.
EoTp enable / disable for interoperability with v1.0 peripherals.
Bidirectional support on Data Lane 0 (mandatory for Command Mode, optional for Video Mode).
PLL providing Clock Lane DDR frequency on host; CDR / clock recovery on peripheral.
Vendor sideband (e.g. backlight, panel-reset GPIOs) outside DSI scope.

pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.max_trace_length_cm: ≤ 30 cm at sub-Gbps rates; shorter at higher rates (per D-PHY).
pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential.

low_power_modes.ULPS: Ultra-Low Power State — lane held LP-00 indefinitely; deep sleep.
low_power_modes.Non_Continuous_Clock: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between bursts; saves clock-tree power.
low_power_modes.BLLP_LP_substitution: In Video Mode, sufficient time during HBP / HFP / blanking allows transition to LP for power saving instead of sending Blanking Packets.

typical_use_cases: Mobile-phone primary display (active-matrix LCD or OLED with on-panel display controller).
Tablet display panel link from application processor to display module.
Video Mode handheld display without on-panel frame buffer — host streams pixel data at refresh rate.
Command Mode handheld display with on-panel frame buffer — host writes pixels into panel's memory, panel refreshes autonomously.
Multi-peripheral display panel where one driver IC per region uses VC[1:0] to demultiplex traffic on a shared physical DSI Link (informative).
